established_by_note: THIS IS NOT THE HUMAN LOOK BLOCKER 1 ASKS FOR. Every frame below was opened with an image reader and judged one at a time, and what was seen is written down per frame rather than asserted in aggregate — but the reader is a model of the same family as the one that wired this pipeline up, i.e. a CORRELATED OBSERVER, capable of reproducing the same misreading on both sides. The same weakness, in the same words, as runs/t040-identity-prompt/calibration-2/probe_observations.json's seed pass. What is NOT model judgement here is the measurement: the mask areas, detection scores, plate-overlap fractions and adjacent-frame centroid steps are in MASK_AUDIT.json and can be checked against the pictures by anyone.
how_they_were_produced: scripts/audit_apple_masks.py over 12 of 402 episodes of the H.264 lossless corpus, driving scripts/estimators/apple_sam2.py UNMODIFIED at its committed operating point (box_threshold 0.15, text_threshold 0.25, one (0.10,0.10) retry, highest-score box). Run on the WORKSTATION on CPU (WAM_PR08_DEVICE=cpu), not on the cluster and not on a GPU, at the three checkpoints pinned in the adapter — the same commits 102_stage_sam2_weights.sbatch staged. It is a dry run of the cluster job, not the cluster job.
what_this_found: 156 of the 169 segmented frames are a correct, tight mask of the fruit. 9 frames — episode_000094 f109-f144 — are a confident, well-formed mask of THE PLATE, at scores 0.155-0.259, ~31000 px, plate overlap 0.985-0.992, zero IoU with the colour heuristic. All 9 are frames in which the robot's hand has hidden the fruit almost completely (54-448 px of apple visible). None of them is a no-detection: coverage over this sample is 1.000, which is exactly the weak witness blocker 1 says it is. The (0.10, 0.10) RETRY NEVER FIRED on any of the 169 frames, so the wrong-object masks were bought by the PRIMARY 0.15 threshold and not by the retry — a sharper statement than blocker 2's, and one that points at the operating point itself.
